Sweet Bacon Wrapped Sausage
By: Cody S.
Published: Tuesday, April 5, 2011 - 10:21am

Ingredients




12 sausage links (Jimmy Dean's)
1/2 A a package of Bacon Strips (uncooked)
1 cup brown cinnamon sugar

Preparation

1 Pre-heat the oven to 400 degrees. 2 Cut sausage links in half. 3 Cut bacon strips into thirds. 4 Wrap sausage with bacon, and stick with a toothpick to hold. 5 Place in oven for 10 minutes, or until meat is fully cooked.
